instruction.name: armmfflag
instruction.description: Read selected ARM flags from ARMFLAGS, as determined by mask, and pack them into rd.

operands.name: mask
operands.description: flag-selection mask (0xf selects N, Z, C, V)

experiments.name: extra armmfflag calibration
experiments.notes: Calibration experiment (not used for the reported latency).

latencies.notes: 3 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. Unroll 10000, iters 1000.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: armmfflag $r12, 0xf; armmfflag $r13, 0xf; armmfflag $r14, 0xf; armmfflag $r15, 0xf; armmfflag $r16, 0xf; armmfflag $r17, 0xf; armmfflag $r18, 0xf; armmfflag $r19, 0xf
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; armmtflag $r0, 0xf
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 10000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; armmtflag $r0, 0xf' --asm 'armmfflag $r12, 0xf; armmfflag $r13, 0xf; armmfflag $r14, 0xf; armmfflag $r15, 0xf; armmfflag $r16, 0xf; armmfflag $r17, 0xf; armmfflag $r18, 0xf; armmfflag $r19, 0xf'
